 Order

This Criminal Miscellaneous Case is filed to quash the proceedings in C.C. No.318/2021 on the file of Judicial Magistrate of First Class Court, Ambalapuzha arising from Crime No.471/2015 of Ramankary Police Station, Alappuzha.

entities.text: Judicial Magistrate of First Class Court, Ambalapuzha
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The above case is charge sheeted against the petitioner alleging offences punishable under Sections 120B, 420, 465 and 468 r/w 34 of IPC.

2. After hearing Adv. T.G. Rajendran in detail, I am of the considered opinion that the petitioner can be allowed to file a discharge CRL. M.C. NO.9754 OF 2023 petition before the court below, if charge is not framed and there can be a direction to consider the same, within a time frame.
The presence of the petitioner can be dispensed with till final orders are passed in the discharge petition.

Therefore, this Criminal Miscellaneous Case is disposed of in the following manner:
1. The petitioner is free to file a discharge petition before the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court, Ambalapuzha, within three weeks from the date of receipt of a stamped certified copy of this order, if charge is not framed.

entities.text: Judicial First Class Magistrate Court, Ambalapuzha
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. Once such a discharge petition is received, the learned Magistrate will consider the same and pass appropriate CRL. M.C. NO.9754 OF 2023 orders in it, after giving an opportunity of hearing to the petitioner and the Prosecutor concerned, within a period of six weeks from the date of receipt of the discharge petition.

3. If a discharge petition is filed as directed above, the presence of the petitioner shall not be insisted by the Magistrate, till final orders are passed in the discharge petition.
4.
All the contentions raised by the petitioner in this criminal miscellaneous case are left open.
